npcs.name: Magister Quen
npcs.description: Town Mage associated with a narrow tower with copper gutters.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a town mage and someone will point you to Magister at a narrow tower with copper gutters. At 312, this Elf has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Magister answers practical questions with theory first, and is rarely without focus crystal cracked and still used. Watched by Caldus; trades with Pire; buys from Vela. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to stabilize a ward that could spare the town another flood fire. What keeps them careful is a temple-led ban on private laboratories. To a DM, Magister is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Ordered a restricted treatise through Vela the same week Caldus copied a matching page.

npcs.voice: Speaks like a Elf town mage: concrete details first, embellishment only when useful.
npcs.appearance: Elf; often near a narrow tower with copper gutters; look for focus crystal cracked and still used.

npcs.name: Hala Quill
npcs.description: Public Scribe associated with a public writing desk by the fountain.
npcs.biography: Hala Quill works as a public scribe out of a public writing desk by the fountain, a 30-year-old Human with more town memory than most council minutes. Hala offers fair rates and unfair honesty, and is rarely without traveling inkwell on a chain. Honest counterpoint to Orin; helps Penna overflow work. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to open a small school for girls' letters. What keeps them careful is being forced to copy forgeries. To a DM, Hala is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Refused Pale Orin's request to 'borrow' her official nib cut.

npcs.name: Vonn Dustmere
npcs.description: Library Archivist associated with the town library stacks.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a library archivist and someone will point you to Vonn at the town library stacks. At 63, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Vonn dusts spines like soothing animals, and is rarely without catalog cards in three conflicting systems. Works near Vela's rare shelf; aids Olda. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to finish a single coherent index before he dies. What keeps them careful is damp destroying the flood-year records. To a DM, Vonn is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Found a missing chronicle volume returned with mill chalk on the cover.

npcs.name: Pire Saltglass
npcs.description: Alchemist associated with a fume-stained shop with open windows.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a alchemist and someone will point you to Pire at a fume-stained shop with open windows. At 74, this Gnome has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Pire labels explosions as 'educational', and is rarely without goggles with one lens tinted rose. Colleague to Quen; evidence path to Nedda. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to invent a safe lamp oil that smugglers can't dilute. What keeps them careful is Quen's ward drawing lightning to the street. To a DM, Pire is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Tested a sample from Nedda's 'grain' and found lamp oil cut with pitch.

npcs.name: Nym Fairchart
npcs.description: Cartographer associated with survey posts outside the walls.
npcs.biography: Most days begin the same for Nym Fairchart: a 42-year-old Human cartographer moving through survey posts outside the walls as if the stones themselves keep appointments with them. Nym humming while measuring angles, and is rarely without case of chalk sticks in coded colors. Marks confused Sol; maps desired by Mouse and Jor. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to publish a public town map that settles property fights. What keeps them careful is their maps being used for invasion or crime. To a DM, Nym is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Chalk marks in the cloister matched a survey line aimed at the old mill.

npcs.name: Olda Runebridge
npcs.description: Town Historian associated with stone benches and foundation corners.
npcs.biography: Olda Runebridge works as a town historian out of stone benches and foundation corners, a 155-year-old Dwarf with more town memory than most council minutes. Olda rubs inscriptions with reverent thumbs, and is rarely without rubbing charcoal and rice paper. Works with Vonn; theory supports Mouse's maps. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to prove the mill sits on a sealed undercroft. What keeps them careful is new money paving over old truths. To a DM, Olda is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Her rubbing of a foundation stone shows a tunnel arch 'filled by order'.
